answer: We define the cryptoeconomic security of the consensus meadow through a staking mechanism where each validator must lock collateral S. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function acts as a network pulse, enforcing a dynamic opportunity-cost bond. Under a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative, as any detected double-signing triggers a total loss of S. Consequently, this strategic sonnet of Nash equilibria ensures that honest participation remains the dominant strategy.
